failure_modes: Cheap swarm looping over already-discovered facts
Expert capacity spent on volume work
gloss: Mix a few deep experts with cheap or diverse workers, matched to how new the problem is
invariants: Expensive capacity handles judgment; cheap capacity handles volume
mechanism: For a known domain a small number of very experienced agents outperform a large crowd of novices, because they know where to look. For a new paradigm nobody has the answer, so volume and variety win. The allocation of expensive expert capacity versus cheap parallel workers is chosen from how well-mapped the problem is.
